Grade: Grade 4 · Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Hadith on brushing teeth. Watch the example, then you try.”

• read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene
• practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
